{{Top|leg}}
The '''Celanon rakghoul outbreak''' occurred during the era of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] when a sample of the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]] was carried to [[Celanon/Legends|Celanon]] by an unscrupulous trader. Several city blocks were quarantined, and the trader was found out and arrested.<ref>{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Investigation|Disease Control}}</ref>
